name: Shinseiki Evangelion: Eva to Yukai na Nakamatachi
original_name: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン エヴァと愉快な仲間たち
source: By sheer chance, Shinji is forced to participate in a mahjong tournament in which the winner can be granted a wish of any kind. Aiming for the victory, Shinji works hard with his friends in the special training. Characters from Fushigi no Umi no Nadia (i.e. The Secret of the Blue Water) and Top o Nerae! (i.e. Gunbuster) are also attending the tournament for their own dreams.
translation: 阴差阳错之下，真嗣被迫参加了一场麻将大赛。只要夺冠，就能实现任何一个愿望。为了赢得胜利，他与朋友们一起努力特训。《蓝宝石之谜》与《飞跃巅峰！》中的角色，也为了各自的梦想前来参赛。
